as_told.title: Jake told Greer craft were being downed

plain: Steven Greer, a longtime campaigner for UFO disclosure, says that Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot, has been at sites where, in Greer's words, "we" targeted extraterrestrial craft and brought them down. Greer points to a map of such sites around the world in a briefing document he has put together. If true, it would mean humans have been deliberately shooting down craft from elsewhere.
